questions.question_text: What does the ACT Reading Test primarily measure?
options: Your ability to memorize vocabulary lists.
Your speed in skimming long technical reports.
Your ability to read closely and reason logically.
Your knowledge of classic world literature.
questions.explanation: The Reading Test measures your ability to read closely, reason logically, and integrate information from multiple sources.

questions.question_text: How many questions are included in the Reading Test?
questions.explanation: The Reading Test contains 36 questions to be completed in 40 minutes.

questions.question_text: What core skill does the ACT Reading Test primarily measure?
options: The ability to memorize plot points
The ability to read closely and reason logically
The ability to write complex literary critiques
The ability to translate foreign language texts
questions.explanation: The test measures your ability to read closely, reason logically, and integrate information from multiple sources.

questions.question_text: How many questions are included in the ACT Reading Test?
questions.explanation: The ACT Reading Test includes 36 questions.

questions.question_text: What is the time limit for the Reading Test section?
questions.explanation: The time limit for the Reading Test is 40 minutes.

questions.question_text: Is the Reading Test required for all ACT test takers?
options: Yes, it is a required section.
Only for students planning to study English.
Only for students taking the Writing test.
questions.explanation: The ACT consists of English, Math, and Reading as required core tests.
